spec2def(wbemdisp.dll wbemdisp.spec)

add_idl_headers(wbemdisp_idlheader wbemdisp_classes.idl)
add_typelib(wbemdisp_tlb.idl)

list(APPEND wbemdisp_rc_deps
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/wbemdisp_classes.rgs
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/wbemdisp_tlb.rgs
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wbemdisp_tlb.tlb)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE and CONST_VTABLE

# wbemdisp.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wbemdisp-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(wbemdisp_shims OBJECT locator.c main.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(wbemdisp_shims PRIVATE uuid wine oldnames liboleaut32 libole32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(wbemdisp_shims)
add_dependencies(wbemdisp_shims stdole2 wbemdisp_idlheader)
add_cargo_module(wbemdisp wbemdisp-cargo wbemdisp.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/wbem
    EXTRA_DEPENDS wbemdisp_shims psdk ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/wbemdisp_tlb.tlb uuid_sources)
